GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 720 (27 Feb 47) CE
(SCAPIN-2183)
APO 500
6 November 1951
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Disposition of Garbage and Waste.
1. The responsibility of the Japanese Government for the collection of garbage and waste from Occupation Forces installations was set forth in Memorandum for: Japanese Government, file AG 720(27 Feb 47, GD SCAPIN 1548, 27 February 1947, subject: Disposition of Garbage and Waste, supplemented by Memorandum for: Japanese Government, file AG 720(1 Jul 48)GD, SCAPIN 1915, 1 July 1948, subject: Disposition of Garbage and Waste.
2. Effective at the close of business, 31 January 1952, SCAPIN 1548 and SCAPIN 1915 are rescinded and your responsibilities for this service will end. On 1 February 1952, this service will be performed at United States military installations and housing throughout Japan by Japanese contractors through agreements or contracts with the United States military forces.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
C.C.B. WARDEN
Colonel, AGC
Adjutant General
